To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the semantic integration of bioinformatics web services is a feasible approach and that it provides a significant improvement of services discovery and composition.

we have developed a semantic-based bioinformatics services infrastructure that allows the creation of complex scientific workflows and the integration of many service repositories in a unified meta-repository.
the integration of different service registries and the semantic annotation of bioinformatics services is possible and that the proposed semantic infrastructure can provide the required support.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integration of heterogeneous services and data resources and the provision of semantic based querying capabilities for the creation of complex scientific workflows.
the development of a semantic based infrastructure that will enable scientists to create and deploy complex scientific workflows using a variety of web based resources.
the integration of bioinformatics web services using semantic web technologies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed infrastructure is able to provide the means for the semantic integration of heterogeneous services and data resources in a single framework.
the ACGT Semantic Infrastructure is a promising solution for the integration of heterogeneous web resources.
the ACGT infrastructure is a good example of how semantic technologies can be applied to the integration of bioinformatics services.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a framework to enable the integration and reuse of existing services, the integration of new services and the creation of complex workflows that can be easily executed and monitored.
our system allows the creation and publication of complex workflows by using a knowledge-based approach that is able to deal with the semantic heterogeneity of bioinformatics services.
we are building a semantic web infrastructure that can provide a unified view of the services and their capabilities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of semantic metadata and the semantic querying of the meta-repository can significantly improve the efficiency of the service discovery and integration processes.
the integration of services from multiple registries is feasible and that semantic interoperability can be achieved by using semantic annotations of services and their input/output parameters.
the integration of services from different sources can be achieved by using the same semantic model and a common knowledge base.
